assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Godot 2D Chinese small-town community game background, no characters or UI. Input image: the referenced image is a style and architecture reference, not a target to preserve pixel-for-pixel. Create a new very wide approximately 3:1 landscape game environment matching its detailed painterly pixel-like warm autumn dusk palette, grey worn apartment blocks, low brick perimeter wall, street at right leading toward shops, trees and gentle window lights. Technical composition: image maps to a 1600 by 540 world. Wall meets the ground near y=300 (55% down); the entire lower 44% is a broad flat WALKABLE courtyard paved in weathered grey warm stone with only soft autumn leaves and subtle shadows, flat front-facing sidescroller-with-depth perspective, no strong vanishing-point ground slope. Keep all ground x=24..1576 y=300..520 empty and visibly traversable, including empty furniture placement areas around x=240..330 and x=870..1150. No bench, no planters, no bollards, no scooter, no car, no people, no railings blocking the courtyard, no freestanding signs in the floor, no text/sign lettering, no logos/watermark, no baked interaction markers. Upper half architecture and wall, lower half clear paved ground. Furniture will be separate sprites; do not include it. Professional polished raster illustration, not a mockup, no border.
assets.revision_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target. Keep the same warm painterly pixel-like small-town apartment architecture, wall, sunset lighting and no furniture. Change the composition: the bottom of the brick wall MUST be at 55% of image height, not 72%. Expand the empty grey paved courtyard to occupy the entire LOWER 45% of the image. Crop/compress the upper architecture framing to make room for this broad floor; do not add a strip or resize-stretch the old pavement. The wall meets courtyard along one horizontal line at y=400 in a 729px-tall canvas. Repaint a believable broad walkable courtyard across the lower portion, with quiet stone texture, light leaves and soft shadows only. No people, no benches, no planters, no bollards, no vehicles, no freestanding signage or text. About 3:1 wide landscape for 1600x540 game world, polished raster not mockup.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent production game furniture sprite. Draw one worn Chinese neighborhood public bench, weathered brown horizontal wooden slats on black iron legs and armrests. View: front view with a small amount of seat top visible (2D front-facing game with shallow depth), perfectly horizontal seat, no dramatic perspective or tilt. Entire bench visible, centered, wide approx 2.5:1 silhouette, wooden seat at about 63% down the bench silhouette, legs to its bottom. No people, no cigarette, no other furniture, no background scenery/floor/base plate, no logo/text/watermark, transparent alpha outside object including between legs. Small soft contact shadow only. The bench will be placed as a 180px-wide sprite, retain legibility and crisp silhouette, polished painted pixel-ish detail rather than a photorealistic product photograph.
